title: All Things Go 2026: Here’s Where to Shop Affordable Music Festival Tickets Online
summary: Starting on Friday (Sept. 25), the women-forward music festival takes place in New York City and Washington D.C.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

All Things Go Festival is back in action to close out summer festival season. It’s located in two cities on the East Coast starting on Friday (Sept. 25) and ending on Sunday (Sept. 27). In New York City, All Things Go takes place at Forest Hills Stadium in Queens, while it also happens at Merriweather Post Pavilion in Columbia, Maryland (DMV) at the same time.

Its 2026 New York lineup, includes Zara Larsson , Lola Young, comedian Meg Stalter, The Beaches, Carly Rae Jepsen and others. And in the DMV , artists set to perform include Mitski, Ethel Cain, comedian Robby Hoffman, Rico Nasty, Hayley Williams, The Beths, She & Him, Wolf Alice and many more.

Meanwhile, Brandi Carlile is scheduled to headline both locations. Check out a lineup of bands here .

Shop All Things Go Festival Tickets at Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find All Things Go tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.
